title: The weekend / Were you at the ...?
subtitle: 周末 / 你在……吗？

lead.question: 两位太太在街角闲聊：昨天你去肉店了吗、吉米上周缺课没、周末打算去乡下住三天——怎样用 was/were 谈「过去去过某地」，用 be going to 说「将来打算」，用 at/on/in 摆对时间与地点？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象威廉斯太太遇见约翰逊太太：问「你昨天在肉店吗」「吉米上周上学了吗」，回答都用 was/were 的过去式。约翰逊太太说全家要在乡下妈妈家过周末三天——这是 be going to 的将来计划。听录音时抓 be 的过去式 Was/Were 一般疑问与否定，以及介词 at（小地点/时刻）、on（星期）、in（乡村/月份）的分工。
goals: 能用 Was/Were 一般疑问句与否定句谈过去（Were you at ...? / No, I wasn't.）
能用 be absent from 表示「缺席」
能用 be going to 说将来计划（spend ... in the country / stay at my mother's）
掌握介词 at / on / in 表时间与地点（at the butcher's, on Monday, in the country, for the weekend）
理解 Aren't you lucky! 这类否定疑问表感叹
lead.summary: 第 67 课约翰逊太太与威廉斯太太闲聊：两人是否去了肉店/蔬果店，吉米上周周一到周四缺课，约翰逊一家将在乡下妈妈家过周末三天——威廉斯太太羡慕地说 Aren't you lucky!。全课引入 be 的过去式与 be going to。第 68 课用 Were you at the ___? 轮换商店与星期，操练 was/were 过去式。
lead.tips: ① was/were 是 be 的过去式，Was I/He/She/It，Were you/we/they；② 回答 Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.；③ be absent from school 缺课；④ be going to + 动原 表将来计划；⑤ at the butcher's（小地点，'s 表店铺），on Monday（星期用 on），in the country（乡村加 the），for the weekend（持续一段）；⑥ Aren't you lucky! 否定疑问表感叹。

questions.q: Where are the Johnsons going to spend the weekend?
questions.zh: 约翰逊一家周末打算在哪儿过？
questions.a: In the country, at Mrs Johnson's mother's.
questions.aZh: 在乡下，约翰逊太太的母亲家。
questions.hint: 听 We're going to spend three days in the country. We're going to stay at my mother's for the weekend.

questions.q: Was Jimmy at school last week?
questions.a: No, he was absent on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.
questions.aZh: 没有，他周一至周四缺席。

questions.q: How does Mrs Williams answer 'How are you all keeping?'?
questions.zh: 威廉斯太太怎么回答「你们身体都好吗」？

questions.q: Why does Mrs Williams say 'Aren't you lucky!'?
questions.zh: 威廉斯太太为什么说「你们真幸运」？
questions.a: Because the Johnsons will spend Friday, Saturday and Sunday in the country.
questions.aZh: 因为约翰逊一家要在乡下过周五、周六、周日。

questions.q: Why does the text use 'Were you at the butcher's?' with was/were instead of 'are'?
questions.zh: 为什么用 was/were 而不是 are？
questions.a: The conversation is about a past visit (yesterday / earlier today), so it uses the past tense of be. Answers: Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.
questions.aZh: 对话讲的是过去去过某地，所以用 be 的过去式；答 Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.
questions.hint: 一般过去时中 be 用 was/were。

questions.q: Were you at the butcher's? Yes, I was. When? On Tuesday. / Were you at the greengrocer's? Yes, I was. When? On Monday.
questions.zh: 第 68 课操练：Were you at the ___? — Yes, I was. When? — On ___.
questions.a: Were you at the dairy? Yes, I was. When? On Wednesday.
questions.aZh: 你在乳品店吗？在。什么时候？周三。

drill.zh: 你在……吗？——在。什么时候？——在……。（用 was/were 过去式轮换商店与星期）

Were you at the greengrocer's? Yes, I was. When? On Monday.

grammar.title: be 动词的过去式 Was / Were（一般疑问与否定）
grammar.structure: Was/Were + 主语 + ...? ；主语 + was/were + not ...
grammar.definition: was/were 是 be 的过去式。Was 用于 I/he/she/it，Were 用于 you/we/they。一般疑问句 Was/Were 提前，回答 Yes, ... was/were. 或 No, ... wasn't/weren't.。否定在 was/were 后加 not。
grammar.usage: Were you at the butcher's? — Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.

examples.en: Were you at the butcher's?
He was absent on Monday.

grammar.title: be going to 表示将来计划（复现）
grammar.structure: 主语 + am/is/are going to + 动词原形
grammar.definition: be going to 表示已经决定或计划好的将来行为，强调主观打算。本课用于安排周末去处。
grammar.usage: We're going to spend three days in the country. / We're going to stay at my mother's.

examples.en: We're going to spend three days in the country.
examples.zh: 我们打算在乡下度过三天。

examples.en: We're going to stay at my mother's for the weekend.
examples.zh: 我们打算在妈妈家过周末。

grammar.title: 介词 at / on / in 表示时间与地点
grammar.structure: at（小地点/时刻）、on（星期/日期）、in（乡村/月份/年份/一天中的时段）
grammar.definition: at 用于小地点（at the butcher's, at home）与确切时刻（at 10 o'clock）；on 用于星期与具体日期（on Monday, on Tuesday）；in 用于乡村（in the country）、月份、年份、一天中的时段（in the morning）。for + 时间段表示持续（for the weekend）。
grammar.usage: at the butcher's / on Monday / in the country / for the weekend
